parameters.content:
## WORKFLOW 2 · WEATHER BRANCH

Manual = latest Aichi bulletin from recovery history. Scheduled = every minute; hourly recovery at minute 00. UNPUBLISHED: no automatic runs.

VPWW53 / Aichi 230000. Nagoya municipality code is 2310000 (different from GSI city code). Stores latest bulletin only, including corrections and raw lifted/no-warning statuses. Bulletin cancellation = unknown status. Not a full event archive.

Cloud Run handoff queued before storage; delivery disabled pending setup. No phone notifications. Earthquake/tsunami/volcano branch is below. Municipal evacuation orders are not ingested. App decides user location. Run sequentially; no cross-run lock. Empty feed means no new data, never an all-clear.

JMA public PULL can delay. Review source timestamps. Minute polling uses roughly 43,200 scheduled executions per 30 days if enabled; verify n8n plan allowance.

nodes.name: How to use this warning collector

parameters.content:
## EARTHQUAKE · TSUNAMI · VOLCANO

Second JMA feed: eqvol / eqvol_l. Same manual + minute triggers. Latest 3 unseen bulletins PER TYPE per run; remaining history is backfilled on later recovery runs.

Supported: VXSE53 detailed earthquake information, VTSE41 tsunami warnings/advisories/forecasts, VFVO50 volcanic warnings/forecasts. Other bulletin codes are skipped. Not earthquake early warning.

Nationwide archive, separate from Aichi weather. Raw categories, affected areas, event IDs, revisions and cancellations retained. aichiMentioned is an explicit mention only, never a safety assessment. Cloud Run handoff queued before storage; delivery disabled pending setup. No user-location matching, Workflow 1 call or phone notifications.

Empty or duplicate feeds skip storage. Run sequentially; no lock/retention. Unpublished: no automatic runs.

nodes.notes: SETUP REQUIRED: attach a Custom Auth credential with template {"headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer {{api_key}}"}}. The backend must validate this shared ingestion token. Keep it out of node parameters and exports.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {processed: $input.all().length, meaning: 'Completed attempts; inspect outbox for acknowledged or pending rows', notificationsSent: false}}];

parameters.content:
## CLOUD RUN → FCM · SETUP REQUIRED

Draft only. Delivery configuration and HTTP sender start disabled; no endpoint or credentials exist yet. Collection writes a durable outbox BEFORE marking bulletins processed. Training/test reports are excluded.

Enable the HTTP sender and set enabled=true and endpointUrl only after deploying the authenticated ingestion API and assigning Custom Auth credentials to Send warning to Cloud Run. API contract and Firebase/Android setup: docs/notifications.md.

A separate trigger branch retries up to 3 oldest pending rows each run, even with no new bulletins. HTTP failures and invalid acknowledgements return to the loop and stay pending. HTTP retries twice; backend MUST deduplicate deliveryKey and persist FCM work before accepted=true. Backend acceptance does not mean phone delivery.

Backend decides affected users, meaningful changes and expiry. Never push historical backfill blindly. Cancellations remain unknown, never all-clear. Run sequentially; no cross-run lock. Already archived bulletins are not automatically backfilled into the outbox.
